claims.vector: KV-1: Zero-price bypass via SqrtPriceCalculator.computeRatioX96() returning 0
claims.reason: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow, but AMMStandardHook._validatePricingBounds (line 847) explicitly checks sqrtPriceX96 == 0 and reverts with AMMStandardHook__InvalidPrice.

claims.vector: KV-2: Direct handler call bypassing pricing enforcement
claims.reason: CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer requires msg.sender == AMM. Direct external call reverts.

claims.vector: KV-3: Settings sync gap in CLOBTransferHandler / CreatorHookSettingsRegistry
claims.reason: CLOBTransferHandler reads settings from AMM via ILimitBreakAMM.getTokenSettings() on each openOrder call. Cache invalidation handled by syncTokenSettings callback.

claims.vector: KV-4: Transient storage leak in DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT
claims.reason: beforeSwap always writes before afterSwap reads within same swap. Second direct swap in same TX overwrites slot in its own beforeSwap. Confirmed via C1 Forge test.

claims.vector: Re-enter via transfer handler during swap to read stale reserves
claims.reason: CLOBTransferHandler has nonReentrant. AMM ENTERED bit blocks callbacks. Reserves updated atomically in _poolSwapByInput before afterSwap hooks.

claims.vector: Multi-swap within hook callback overwrites transient slot mid-swap
claims.reason: Hook callbacks execute during AMM nonReentrant guard. Second swap attempt hits ENTERED bit and reverts. Confirmed via C2 Forge test.

claims.vector: Native ETH refund during hook enables reentrancy
claims.reason: _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess sends ETH inside nonReentrant guard. Low-level call with empty calldata gives 2300 gas. ENTERED guard blocks reentry. Confirmed via C2 extended Forge test.

claims.vector: CLOB settlement callback reads AMM state before swap finalizes
claims.reason: ammHandleTransfer called after pool reserves updated by _poolSwapByInput. Handler uses AMM-passed parameters, not direct AMM state reads.
_setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) preserves ENTERED bit via mask. Token transfer callbacks face ENTERED guard. Confirmed via C10 Forge test.
Rounding favors protocol (mulDivRoundingUp). Each tiny swap loses dust to pool. Confirmed via Forge test: 25 round-trip swaps, no profit.

claims.vector: Forged hook caller with fake pool identity
claims.reason: _requireCallerIsAMM checks msg.sender == AMM on all hook entry points.

claims.vector: Permit mutation replay with unsigned feeOnTop
claims.reason: limitAmount caps total exposure. Known design property per Guardian Defender submission #8.

claims.vector: Storage-slot collision across diamond proxy facets
claims.reason: All AMM state at Diamond slot 0x9A1D via AppStorage. Pool types use delegatecall with same layout. 6-leading-zero-byte constraint prevents address collision.

claims.evidence: CLOB fills use stored currentPrice (CLOBHelper.sol:180-239), not AMM curve price. No shared oracle between venues.

claims.thesis: Controlled hook returns fake sqrtPriceX96 in SingleProviderPool, attacker swaps at rigged price
claims.asset: Token output difference at manipulated vs fair price
claims.evidence: Pool hook set at creation by LP, cannot be changed. Price bounded by MIN/MAX_SQRT_RATIO (SingleProviderPoolType.sol:328-330). Attacker-controlled pool only harms voluntary users (Tier B).

claims.thesis: Dust-loop rounding extraction: iterated 1-wei swaps compound rounding errors
claims.victim: LP reserves in any pool type
claims.asset: Accumulated rounding dust over thousands of swaps
claims.evidence: Rounding favors protocol (mulDivRoundingUp for charges, mulDiv for payouts). Fuzz testing 36 tests confirms no round-trip profit. Max compound error is 1 wei per operation, not economically viable after gas.

claims.reason: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow but bounds check catches it when minSqrtPriceX96 > 0. Low severity — requires no bounds set.

claims.title: feeOnTop not in permit signature
claims.reason: feeOnTop paid by swapper. Malicious relayer can only grief, not extract funds. Not insolvency.

claims.title: Transient storage not cleared after direct swap
claims.reason: EIP-1153 clears transient storage at end of tx. No cross-tx risk.

claims.title: swapExtraData silent default
claims.reason: Silent default uses valid parameters. Swap executes correctly with proper fee/reserve accounting.

claims.verdict: Protocol is well-hardened against insolvency vectors. No exploitable paths found.
